thread:
evan: Heads-up — CCS demo team wants a short reserved window this weekend (Sat 10–14 UTC). Anyone know if we can carve from the demo pool or need a formal quota bump?
maya: Which region and GPU type?
evan: eu-west1, want 4x A100 for a rolling 2h run each hour between 10–14. Low sustained p99 latency requirement.
leo: We might be tight on demo pool for that window, EU demo already has two stands. Can you share tenant id?
evan: tenant_ccs_42
ops-bot: @channel Automated quota check result for tenant_ccs_42:
ops-bot: ```
current_allocated: 0
soft_quota_limit: 8 GPUs
hard_quota_limit: 8 GPUs
reserved_pools: ["eu-demo-standby"]
available_in_reserved_pools: 2 GPUs
```
maya: ops-bot shows 2 available in eu-demo-standby — not enough for 4x.
jen: If it's short-lived we can do a manual carve from the demo pool if owners approve. @procurement-bot can you tag owners and suggest a temporary carve?
procurement-bot: Request created: PRQ-8421. Notifying pool owners: @leo @paul_ops. Please approve within next 2 hours to meet scheduling.
leo: I can approve one-time carve for 2 GPUs only (safest). For full 4 GPUs we need to either move some EU demo work or spin on-demand from cloud (higher cost).
evan: If we fallback to on-demand, what's the quick estimate?
maya: For 4x A100 on-demand for 4 hours in eu-west1 ballpark ~ $2k.
jen: Another option: split the job across two windows (2 GPUs each) and use KV-cache warmup to keep perf. That would avoid carve.
evan: Splitting is doable but adds scheduling complexity for the demo team. Can we reserve 2 GPUs now and then attempt to borrow additional 2 mid-run?
leo: Approving 2 GPUs now. If the other pools free up, ops can escalate for a temporary bump.
ops-bot: Approved one-time carve: 2 GPUs from eu-demo-standby to tenant_ccs_42. Expires 1742540000 (approx 11h).
jen: I'll coordinate with the demo team on split runs and update the runbook. evan, can you add the follow-up in the runbook and ping when you need the extra burst?
evan: Will do. Adding note to runbook and will ping in #eng-infra if we need the extra 2 as we ramp. Thanks all :thumbsup:
leo: FYI — ops, can we add an alert if reserved pool usage drops below 20% next 24h so we can proactively free?
ops-bot: Logged: SRE-issue-317 -> monitor reserved pool utilization and notify.
